documents.text: WebGPU accelerates browser machine learning inference using the local graphics processor. It executes tensor operations on the user's device without a cloud inference API.
WebAssembly, or WASM, provides a CPU fallback when a browser does not support WebGPU or GPU initialization fails. Local embedding inference can still run on the CPU.
INT8 quantization stores model weights as eight bit integers instead of 32 bit floating point numbers. This reduces model download size. Retrieval quality should be measured using Recall and nDCG.
seekdb hybrid search combines full text keyword matching and semantic vector similarity in the database. Reciprocal rank fusion, RRF, ranks candidates from both retrieval methods.
After importing documents into seekdb, refresh the vector index before searching the new documents. Batch writes followed by a single index refresh reduce repeated refresh overhead.

Embedding batch processing encodes multiple documents in one inference call. Reusing the loaded model avoids initialization overhead on subsequent queries. Warm and cold timings must be measured separately.

Each knowledge base binds a model revision, precision, pooling strategy and dimension. Switching knowledge bases must not mix incompatible embedding vectors. Stable document IDs make incremental upserts idempotent.
Mean pooling combines token representations into a sentence embedding. L2 normalization scales the embedding to unit length. MiniLM sentence embeddings have 384 dimensions.
Sourdough bread is made from flour, water, salt and an active starter. A long fermentation improves flavor and texture. Bake in a hot oven.
Tomato plants need sunlight, regular watering and well drained soil. Mulch helps retain moisture. Harvest ripe tomatoes gently from the vine.
High speed trains connect cities on a railway network. Passengers should arrive at the station early and check the platform number printed on the departure board.
